title: Crimson Isle
summary: Hypixel's nether island over a lava sea - Elle, the Mage and Barbarian factions, reputation and daily faction quests, the five minibosses, its mobs, Trophy Fishing with Odger, Kuudra, the Dojo, Vulcan's Crimson stars and the Inferno Demonlord.

, a crater of lava with a fortified platform and a ballista in the middle and six islets around it on bridges. Fall in the lava and it throws you back onto the platform.
Six supply crates sit on the islets. Right-click one to pick it up (you're slow while carrying it) and bring it to the ballista.
Stand by the ballista to build it: the more of you, the faster.

Kuudra rises in the east. Fuel cells wash up on the islets two at a time; carry them to the ballista. Each one is a shot: right-click the ballista's back to fire. A shot takes a tenth of Kuudra's health and
it beside the platform for 10 seconds, and only then can you hurt it.

All through, Kuudra's followers climb out of the lava in waves (Kuudra Followers, Knockers, Magma Followers, Wandering Blazes, and Berserkers from Hot up), and every few seconds Kuudra slams down where someone stands (a ring of fire warns first). From
, two tentacles grab the platform after each stun and the ballista won't fire until they're dead. From
, Kuudra heals while it isn't stunned. In
, below a quarter of its health, it slams twice as often. Going down isn't the end: you're back on the platform after 10 seconds, but if everyone is down at once, Kuudra wins.
